# CUTIBACTERIUM (FORMERLY PROPIONIBACTERIUM) SPECIES

Isolation of Cutibacterium species from a culture often represents contamination

or colonization and not disease. For questions about whether a patient should be

treated, contact Infectious Diseases.

Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See

disease/syndrome sections for more information.

[Acne](acne)

# Preferred treatment

For intravenous treatment options, please refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS.
